*Write sharp X posts and threads in your own voice, published free through Typefully.*

> **Never auto-publish.** A human approves every tweet, every time, and that is permanent.

## Why install this

X removed its API free tier in February 2026 — new developer accounts pay per
post. Typefully's free plan covers one connected X account and about 15 posts a
month behind a clean public API, which is the right price for a personal posting
cadence.

ghostwriter-x works in three moves: **learn your voice** from your own tweet
archive, **draft** a post or thread, **you approve**, then it **publishes**
through Typefully to your connected X account.

Every tweet is validated against X's real weighted 280-character rules *before
you see it*, so a draft that looks fine and would be rejected never reaches you.

## What you get

| Path | What it provides |
|---|---|
| `skills/ghostwriter-x/SKILL.md` | The flow Claude follows, and where it must stop and ask. |
| `skills/ghostwriter-x/scripts/typefully_post.py` | Publishes a post or thread (`--dry-run` previews, `--connect` sets up). |
| `skills/ghostwriter-x/scripts/x_len.py` | Weighted 280-character validation, twitter-text rules. |
| `skills/ghostwriter-x/scripts/extract_tweets.py` | Turns your archive's `tweets.js` into voice-analysis input. |
| `skills/ghostwriter-x/scripts/verify_sources.py` | The source gate: every external claim needs 3+ live distinct hosts. |
| `skills/ghostwriter-x/scripts/render_image.py`, `render_carousel.py`, `card_lint.py` | 16:9 card rendering and lint. |
| `skills/ghostwriter-x/assets/` | Landscape card templates, the card language, vendored `mermaid.min.js`. |
| [`COMPLIANCE.md`](COMPLIANCE.md) | Why review-then-publish is permanent. |

## Quick start

```bash
python3 scripts/typefully_post.py --connect     # one-time, stores your social set id
python3 scripts/extract_tweets.py               # turn your archive into voice input
python3 scripts/typefully_post.py --dry-run     # see the payload without posting
```

Then just ask:

- *"Tweet something about what's trending in my field."*
- *"Draft a thread on &lt;your topic&gt;."*
- *"Turn my last devlog into an X thread."*

Claude drafts in your voice, shows every tweet numbered with its live weighted
character count (`[3/7 · 262/280]`), and on your OK publishes through Typefully.

Install from the [claude-skills marketplace](https://github.com/natejswenson/claude-skills),
then say **"set up ghostwriter-x"**.

## Triggers

- "tweet"
- "thread"
- "X post"
- Drafting, writing or posting something to X or Twitter.
- Setting up X posting.

## Requirements

- Python 3 standard library only for the core — publishing and validation need no
  third-party packages.
- A [Typefully](https://typefully.com) account with your X account connected, and
  an API key from Settings → API. No OAuth dance, no token expiry.
- Optional, for cards: Playwright + Chromium in a local `.venv`.

## One-time setup

1. **Typefully account.** Sign up and **connect your X account** in their UI.
2. **API key.** Typefully → **Settings → API** → create a key.
3. `cp .env.example .env` (into `~/.claude/ghostwriter-x/`) and paste the key in
   as `TYPEFULLY_API_KEY`.
4. **Connect:** `python3 scripts/typefully_post.py --connect`.
5. **Export your tweets:** X → Settings → *Your account* → *Download an archive
   of your data*. Drop the archive's `data/tweets.js` into `data/`, run
   `python3 scripts/extract_tweets.py`, then ask Claude to *"build my voice
   profile"*. Already using the LinkedIn `ghostwriter` skill? Claude can seed the
   X profile from that one instead, with no archive needed to start.
6. **Set your interests and voice notes:**
   `cp voice/interests.example.md voice/interests.md` and
   `cp voice/voice-notes.example.md voice/voice-notes.md`. Both are gitignored.

### Optional: the Typefully MCP server

Typefully ships an MCP server giving Claude a direct tool interface to your
drafts, queue and analytics. Add it at **user scope** so it works from any
directory:

```
claude mcp add -s user -t http typefully "https://mcp.typefully.com/mcp?TYPEFULLY_API_KEY=<your key>"
```

The skill does not require it — `scripts/typefully_post.py` talks to the REST API
directly.

## How it works

```
tweets.js (your X archive) ──> extract_tweets.py ──> data/my_posts.md
                                                          │
                                                          ▼
                                          Claude builds voice/voice-profile.md
                                                          │
   topic (news / interests / ad-hoc) ─────────────────────┤
                                                          ▼
                                          Claude drafts ──> drafts/*.md
                                                          │  (numbered tweets, live char counts,
                                                          ▼   you read & approve)
                                          typefully_post.py ──> Typefully ──> your X timeline
```

## X-specific rules baked in

- **280 weighted characters per tweet, enforced before preview.** URLs always
  count 23, most emoji and CJK count 2. `scripts/x_len.py` implements the
  twitter-text rules conservatively: if it passes here, it fits on X.
- **The first tweet is the hook.** There is no "…see more" fold on X; tweet 1
  must stand alone and earn the tap. `voice/algorithm.md` carries the reach
  mechanics.
- **Links go in a reply, not tweet 1** — external links in the main post suppress
  reach.
- **Threads over long-form.** Threads are the native long format; the skill
  steers toward 7 tweets or fewer, drafted as complete-thought tweets split on
  `---` lines.

## Optional: cards and carousels at 16:9

Any post can carry a composed PRESS card, rendered locally at 1200×675 (X's
landscape crop) with your own brand guide (`assets/diagram.css`, gitignored). An X
"carousel" is a **4-image post** (cover / point / point / recap) or a
thread-with-images, never a PDF.

```bash
python3 -m venv .venv
.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements-diagrams.txt
.venv/bin/playwright install chromium
```

Rendering is fully local; PNGs live in `images/` (gitignored) and every image
gets alt text.

## Optional: the release radar

`scripts/release_radar.sh` runs a headless Claude research session and writes a
dated digest of recent developments to `research/`, each item paired with a
suggested post or thread angle. Schedule it with
`bash scripts/install_radar.sh` (macOS launchd; re-run whenever the repo moves).
**The radar only researches — it never posts.**

## Security

- The only secret is your Typefully API key, in `.env` (gitignored);
  `.env.example` ships placeholders only. Revoke it any time at typefully.com →
  Settings → API.
- Your tweet archive, drafts, digests and filled-in voice files are gitignored.
- The core is Python 3 standard library only. The optional card feature is the one
  exception.

## Notes and limits

- **Free plan limits:** one connected X account, about 15 posts a month. The
  script surfaces Typefully's 402 and 429 responses plainly instead of retrying
  past them.
- **Review-then-publish is permanent, not a v1 limitation.** This skill never
  posts unattended.
- Outcome tracking is self-reported: the skill asks how a post did a couple of
  days later and learns from that.
- Publishing is asynchronous on Typefully's side. The script polls until the post
  is live and prints the X URL. If it ever times out, check the printed Typefully
  draft link before re-running, to avoid a double post.

## Development

```bash
cd skills/ghostwriter-x/skills/ghostwriter-x
pip install -r requirements-dev.txt
pytest
```

Python skill. `ci / ghostwriter-x` runs the same tests plus the house lints on
every pull request. The baseline is pinned against 6 published, user-approved
drafts and catches 280-weighted-length regressions.
